title: pneumonanthe saponaria
intro: Pneumonanthe saponaria, commonly known as Lungwort, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Gentianaceae. It is valued for its therapeutic properties, particularly in the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its ability to soothe and calm the lungs. The health benefits of Pneumonanthe saponaria include its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help to clear mucus from the lungs and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycosides, flavonoids, and iridoid glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of expectoration, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties.
